sections.heading: Business
sections.markdown: Consumer Cyclical / Auto Parts · Indonesia. PT. Gajah Tunggal Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells tires in Indonesia, America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, Australia, and Oceania. It offers tyres, tyre cords, synthetic rubber, and tire rubber, inner tubes, flaps, and o-rings, as well as nylon filament yarns.
